plugin.source:
Test address here, You know how I sometimes like to take some time alone, in the meadows. Yesterday I spotted a sabrecat. Such a mighty beast, I couldn't help but start sketching it.

I thought I'd send this copy to you as a gift, maybe you can use it to study these beautiful animals without the need to hunt one. Stay safe out there, I hope all your quests go according to plan! Cheers, NPCtest
plugin.target:
Test address here, 你知道我有時喜歡在草地上獨處。昨天我看到了一隻劍齒虎。這麼厲害的野獸，我忍不住開始畫了。

我想我會把這個副本作為禮物送給你，也許你可以用它來研究這些美麗的動物而無需獵殺。在外面保持安全，我希望你所有的任務都按計劃進行！ 乾杯， NPCtest

I hope you're safe out there, and I hope you'll return soon. I'm keeping my equipment at the ready, so that whenever you'll let me come with you, I can come immediately! Love, kidtest

plugin.source:
Set up your set of used appreciation animations for this group.
- "Vanilla hug" is the animation that has been used in all 1.x versions of the mod.
- "Salute" is a vanilla animation where the actors just salute each other.
- "Embrace DAR" is a new hug animation made for the mod by Novum-Semita which looks better in every aspect, but it requires the Dynamic Animation Replacer.

If you do not have DAR installed, you MUST NOT choose options that require it.

Click the name of an animation to toggle it on/off, and click Done when you're ready with this setup.
plugin.target:
為該組設定一組使用過的欣賞動畫。
- “原版擁抱”是已在所有 1.x 版本的 mod 中使用的動畫。
- “敬禮”是一個原版動畫，演員們只是互相敬禮。
- “擁抱 DAR”是 Novum-Semita 為 mod 製作的新擁抱動畫，在各個方面看起來都更好，但它需要動態動畫替換器。

如果您沒有安裝 DAR，則不得選擇需要它的選項。

單擊動畫名稱以將其開啟/關閉，並在準備好此設定後單擊完成。”

It seems you are installing I'm Glad You're Here on a game without SkyUI.
You will need to click through a short installer to set up the mod's animations to your game. You will be shown pages where you can enable/disable animations for groups of NPCs. Each time you appreciate such an NPC, the animation played will be selected selected randomly from the pool you enabled here.

If you have the Dynamic Animation Replacer (DAR) installed, you can select animations with the DAR flag. If you do not have this installed, make sure to turn off all animations with the DAR flag!

The settings you make here are permanent. (That is, until you install SkyUI for your game so that you have access to the MCM).
plugin.target:
看來你正在安裝我很高興你在這裡沒有 SkyUI 的遊戲。
您將需要單擊一個簡短的安裝程式來為您的遊戲設定 mod 的動畫。您將看到可以為 NPC 組啟用/停用動畫的頁面。每次您欣賞這樣的 NPC 時，播放的動畫都會從您在此處啟用的池中隨機選擇。

如果您安裝了動態動畫替換器 (DAR)，則可以選擇帶有 DAR 標誌的動畫。如果您沒有安裝這個，請確保關閉所有帶有 DAR 標誌的動畫！

您在此處所做的設定是永久性的。 （也就是說，直到您為您的遊戲安裝 SkyUI 以便您可以訪問 MCM）。”
